name: INBOUND_SECRET
label: Inbound ingress secret
setupSteps: This gatekeeper has no OAuth app. The only credential it needs is a shared secret for its inbound HTTP ingress, which the MTA presents when handing over a delivered message.
Generate a random value and give the same one to the mail server. Self-hosted deployments have this generated for them by deploy/bootstrap.sh.
Without it the ingress is disabled: it is reachable at the public origin, and delivering a message invokes an agent.
